android_capture_diagnostics.scope: Successful current-session PixelCopy captures, including views not retained as proof. Surface copy/encoding costs only; retained PNG verification and callback costs are excluded.

cap10.window_selection: Exclude main8 which straddles30→10; reports9–15 pure gameplay after state2 and before state3. Renderer11–17 and presentation17–23 approximately aligned separate-thread report windows.

cap30.window_selection: Exclude main16 which straddles10→30 and main29 which includes logout; reports17–28 pure gameplay after state3. Renderer19–30 and presentation25–36 approximately aligned separate-thread report windows.

limits: Native records have no UTC/QPC timestamp or cap label inside each window; cap classification follows ordered main-thread state changes with transition windows excluded.
Both cap routes/actions are unlabelled and may differ. This is evidence of actual cap behavior and bottlenecks, not a controlled performance gain comparison.
Renderer batch covers INITTOPOFFRAME through completed SWAPBUFFER, including queue starvation, scheduling and driver waits; renderer non-swap wall is not pure GL execution time.
Main gfx/backpressure overlap native frame submit/work. Renderer uploads and swap are nested components; do not sum across threads or add nested phases.
Native thread CPU excludes llvmpipe/Wine/FEX worker CPU. Final owned-process sample is after logout and gives lifetime ticks, not gameplay interval CPU or bottleneck causality.

Selected texture-copy/subcopy/VBO callbacks exclude disk/decode and eventual GPU completion; zero framebuffer-readback callback measurements do not rule out readback elsewhere in Wine/presentation bridge.
Successful capture statistics exclude retained PNG verification and callback costs. Off-UI encoding can still compete for CPU.
No evidence establishes a causal fix/regression for the previously reported black glitch, and no controlled physical performance improvement can be claimed.

All emitted main wait_iterations are zero. Backpressure_wall is the wall duration of the instrumented full loop bracket, not proof of actual WaitForSingleObject iterations; scheduling pauses can contribute.
